entries.name: agent-maintenance
entries.purpose: Maintain host profiles, plugin entries, project names, and both Claude and Codex sessions.

entries.name: review
entries.purpose: Find defects and contract violations in existing work.

entries.name: skill-creator
entries.purpose: Author and maintain skills, commands, agents, and their behavior contracts.

entries.name: runtime-adaptation
entries.when: When a needed capability crosses runtime boundaries; probe tools and translate host dialects.

entries.name: refactor
entries.purpose: Improve implementation structure while preserving behavior.

entries.name: second-opinion
entries.purpose: Obtain an independent challenge with evidence and bounded delegation.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.purpose: Inspect and configure host usage and status displays.

entries.name: record-decision
entries.purpose: Compare alternatives and preserve a reasoned decision.

entries.name: slides
entries.purpose: Design and render slide presentations, including design packs.

entries.name: task-delegation
entries.when: When authorized work has a bounded independent subtask and delegation is appropriate.

entries.name: svg-diagram
entries.purpose: Create structured SVG diagrams with geometry validation; raster generation belongs to image-generation.

entries.name: emoji-policy
entries.when: When checking applicable output or organization emoji rules.

entries.name: git-conventions
entries.when: When preparing branches, commits, or pull requests; retain existing host commands.

entries.name: host-audit
entries.when: When installing or updating jstack, or when the user asks to check their host setup: skills, MCP servers, subagents, the description listing budget, or compatibility with jstack.

entries.name: catalog-help
entries.when: When explaining the catalog or resolving a previous skill name.

entries.name: humanize
entries.purpose: Revise writing while preserving meaning; includes technical clarity and narrative research reports under humanize.

entries.name: hwpx-document
entries.purpose: Create and validate HWPX documents.

entries.name: image-generation
entries.purpose: Generate and edit raster images; structured SVG diagrams belong to svg-diagram.

entries.name: model-selection
entries.when: When selecting a model for an authorized task; use observed capability, availability, latency, and cost.

entries.name: office-documents
entries.purpose: Create, edit, and inspect DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files; slide design belongs to slides.

entries.name: plan
entries.purpose: Turn a request into an executable specification and acceptance evidence.

entries.name: korean-proofread
entries.purpose: Check Korean spelling, language constraints, and character counts.

entries.name: remove-capability
entries.purpose: Remove obsolete plugin capabilities after preserving useful behavior and checking references.

entries.name: react-performance
entries.purpose: Diagnose and improve React performance.

entries.name: session-memory
entries.purpose: Recall relevant session history and maintain searchable memory.

entries.name: requirements-interview
entries.purpose: Surface the assumptions behind a request or the work in progress by evidence-first questioning, and record the answers in the spec.

entries.name: research
entries.purpose: Investigate questions and build a verifiable evidence and citation trail.

entries.name: scientific-tools
entries.purpose: Load scientific methods and tools conditionally; preserve bundled upstream guidance.

entries.name: credential-response
entries.purpose: Detect and respond to exposed credentials.

entries.name: repository-setup
entries.purpose: Apply project instructions and portable skill storage conventions.

entries.name: test-driven-development
entries.purpose: Implement thin slices with red-green-refactor; completion assessment belongs to verify.

entries.name: parallel-execution
entries.when: When authorized independent work can run concurrently and needs reconciliation.

entries.name: web-interface
entries.purpose: Review interface behavior and accessibility, and apply web design packs.

entries.name: upstream-maintenance
entries.purpose: Review and integrate upstream changes with provenance.

entries.name: verify
entries.purpose: Assess completion against requirements and observed evidence.

entries.name: wrapup
entries.purpose: Provide an optional convenience surface for explicitly requested personal period reports; any selected workflow may call the shared local work-report core directly.

entries.name: google-workspace
entries.purpose: Operate Google Workspace integrations with task-specific authorization.

entries.name: disk-manager
entries.purpose: Diagnose disk growth, track storage history, and reclaim approved space without deleting persistent data.

entries.name: issue-report
entries.purpose: Record jstack malfunction candidates and submit redacted issue drafts only after the user approves each exact draft.

entries.name: journey-qa
entries.purpose: Walk a product's install and onboarding journeys as a fictitious team in a clean environment and record defects with publishable evidence.

entries.name: sdlc
entries.purpose: Clarify and deliver one explicitly selected software change through scoped release.
